title: Strict Positivity for Fourth-Order Quantum Diffusion
exact_target: Determine whether fourth-order quantum diffusion immediately removes vacuum points from a nonzero density.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001640 (OWR-4536-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: Positive total mass is necessary for a meaningful strict-positivity assertion: zero initial mass gives the zero density in a mass-conserving formulation. The source's brief n_0>=0 notation does not explicitly exclude that boundary case. Pointwise versus almost-everywhere positivity and the chosen weak-solution class must also be fixed; no maximum principle is assumed for this fourth-order equation.
